title: Chapter 214 Killing Anna'S Clone
content:
Chapter 214 Killing Anna'S Clone

Wang Shuo screamed in despair, his heart and liver were about to burst!

He had no time to rescue him at this moment. When he ran to the front, he only had time to catch Ayub's dying body.

Ayub's level at this time was 28, with 3900 HP and 110 defense.

Anna's 8 bone spears, each of which could cause 690 damage to Ayub.

Logically speaking, Ayub had no chance of survival.

But Abu was wearing chain mail, which came with a skill.

[Skill: Iron Wall. Release an absolute defense once, which can reduce the opponent's damage by 99.9%, CD: 30 minutes. ]

After he was stabbed by five bone spears, he finally woke up and activated this skill.

Only then did he leave his last breath and fell into a coma.

Gong Zheng immediately blocked the angry Anna and stopped her from further killing Ayub.

Wang Shuo hurriedly carried Ayub to a safe corner and dripped a drop of water of life into his mouth.

At this time, Ayub's breath was strong and weak, extremely disordered.

After a while, his life value was fully restored, but he did not wake up.

When he was unconscious, Ayub's soul was in a battlefield of fierce fighting.

One of the generals was exactly the same as Ayub, galloping and invincible!

He raised his long sword, and the enemy was lifted into the air and hit by a lightning.

In the dream, Ayub experienced a lot, and after a while, he woke up slowly.

Suddenly, he opened his eyes, and his brilliance flashed.

A momentum suddenly broke out.

Wang Shuo noticed the changes in him and was a little surprised.

Ayub smiled mysteriously, picked up the Qinglong sword, and rushed towards Anna. He lifted Anna into the air with one move, and a lightning suddenly appeared from the void and hit Anna.

"-2500"

Then came another "Purple Thunder Sky Breaking Strike".

"-1200"

Anna's already low health points were reduced to less than 2000 points.

Wang Shuo was surprised, this...

It was like taking some kind of medicine, so fierce that it was a bit unreasonable.

Wang Shuo quickly looked at Ayub's loyalty, and saw that it was still full, so he was relieved.

Wang Shuo looked at his strongest attack - the Dragon Transformation Attack.

He silently shed tears.

His "Dragon Spear Art" was too bad!

Next, Ayub used another set of combos, and with the cooperation of Gong Zheng, he beat Anna without any temper.

"Ah! I'm going to kill you!"

"Damn it!"

The angry roars continued to sound.

When Anna recovered, she also played a set of continuous combination skills.

This stalemate on the battlefield.

Wang Shuo saw that the two were tied up by "Spider Silk Entanglement" again, and his heart tightened, and he joined the battle again.

"Li Jianguo, prepare the bronze crossbow." Wang Shuo roared, desperately holding Anna to prevent her from hurting the trapped Ayub.

In these few short breaths, Wang Shuo can be said to have used all his strength.

"Lord, I'm ready!"

Wang Shuo immediately found the right time and launched the "Iron Chain Binding".

"Swoosh"

The spear pierced into Anna's body.

Finally, her life value was emptied.

Looking at Anna's clone slowly falling, Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

[Your subordinate Li Jianguo killed the golden boss Anna's clone, ID: Long 2035719, and the level was raised to level 29. ]

Li Jianguo is fully worthy of the title of boss killer.

[Your level is raised to level 31. ]

The levels of others have also been raised by one level, and Li Jianguo has even risen by several levels, and his level has caught up with Gong Zheng and Ayub.

Wang Shuo's level jumped to 30 after he killed the Black Dragon King of unknown level. After Anna died, he was promoted to level 30 again.

Wang Shuo immediately walked to Ayub and asked about his condition.
